title: Categorical assembly of projection and integration transpose transport
statement: Let E:C→C′ and H:D→D′ be fully faithful functors of monoidal categories, C,C′ braided, whose images equal object properties PX,PY. Given F:C→D, F′:C′→D′, pullback functors P,P′, b:F⋙H≅E⋙F′, tensor/unit/pullback identifications tX,tY,u,pb [def-pur-finite-ring-site-tensor-transport-data], assume pf is invertible, the projection square commutes, H respects evaluation at u, and E respects braiding under tX. Then for arbitrary chosen adjunctions F⊣R and restricted F′⊣G, the unique counit-normalized right-adjoint comparison exists; the projection maps on comparison images are invertible; and both tensor orders of the integration-transpose identities hold. This is a purely categorical implication, with the image and canonical-map identities as hypotheses.

source.place: Proof (3), finite-ring tensor formula; explicit site transport steps of lem-pur-finite-ring-site-tensor-transpose

proof.text: Lift E,H to the image subcategories; full faithfulness and essential surjectivity make them equivalences. Apply the proved counit-normalized transport and transpose identity.

The commuting projection square expresses the pro projection as a composite of isomorphisms. Set both projection isomorphisms to asIso of the specified maps. The tensor/pullback comparison exhibits tensor closure. Invert the square, use the evaluation identity, and use adjunction naturality to prove the integration formula. Precompose it by the braiding, use braided coherence and braiding naturality to obtain the opposite order.
